question: is the 20-25x bacterial-versus-human gain ratio a SCORING-FRAME artifact rather than a kingdom difference?
headline: PARTIALLY RESOLVED. The decisive gate returned INDETERMINATE and is NOT graded. What IS established: the bacterial label reproducibility rises monotonically across its range (trend +0.9879 against a null max +0.4303, replicated in the mirror direction at +0.9515 vs +0.4499), so the published 0.941 is a POOLED AVERAGE over deciles whose own ceilings run 0.5013 to 0.9823; and the human label is NOT similarly concentrated.

supersedes.retracted_statistic: spearman of a single threshold on the label against the label = 0.8194, reported 2026-11-16 as 87 percent of the achievable ranking signal, and used to infer that the pooled Spearman is overwhelmingly a detection metric
supersedes.why_vacuous: rho = sqrt(3k(n-k)/(n^2-1)) is a closed form in the split proportion alone; at n=44,106 k=14,913 it equals 0.8194 exactly, and uniform, Gaussian, Pareto and bimodal samples all return it to four decimals. The maximum is 0.866 at ANY median split of ANY continuous label.
supersedes.replacement: dna_decode/glm/active_frame.reproducibility_curve, which bins on one replicate group and scores agreement INSIDE the other so the binning variable and the scored pair share no measurement, reported only beside attenuation_null, which holds the design fixed
supersedes.the_retracted_value_is_NOT_deleted: wiki/glm_bacterial_scoring_frame_2026-11-16.json keeps it under RETRACTED_2026_11_16 with a correction_log entry. Deleting the evidence of an error is what lets it be re-derived.

never_cite_for_provenance.why: the contract-number audit verifies a cited number by whole-number presence in the cited artifact, so a contract citing that memo would find the retracted 0.8194 and certify it as provenance. No cell_registry contract cites it today and a test holds that line.

finding_1_reproducibility_rises_across_t.design: bin on RNA_exp_sum_1 (group 1 published summary, itself verified as the exact mean of RNA_exp_sum_1_1 and _1_2 on 44,106 of 44,106 rows); score Spearman between RNA_exp_sum_2_1 and _2_2 inside each decile. The binning variable and the scored pair share NO measurement.

mirror_replication.why_it_is_free: binning on one group and scoring the mirror group reuses the same four columns, so the replication costs nothing and is independent of the first direction binning

finding_1_reproducibility_rises_across_t.reads_as: the trend MUST be read against the null, which reaches +0.4303 on its own: binning on group 1 restricts group 1, which correlates with group 2, so range restriction alone produces substantial apparent slope. +0.9879 is more than double that.
finding_1_reproducibility_rises_across_t.the_consequence_for_every_bacterial_numb: 0.941 is not a single ceiling. It is a pooled average over deciles whose own ceilings run 0.5013 to 0.9823, so an arm reported against 0.941 is judged against a figure that describes no part of the range.

finding_2_the_decisive_gate_did_not_grad.verdict_detail: shuffled-label arm reached |0.0674| against a ceiling of 0.05
finding_2_the_decisive_gate_did_not_grad.framing_recommendation: NO FRAMING CHANGE. An ungraded run cannot inform a scope decision.

ungraded_numbers_DO_NOT_QUOTE_AS_A_RESUL.why_it_is_withheld: the null gate fires FIRST by the bar own ordering. A bar that is overridden once it returns an inconvenient answer is not a bar.

null_diagnosis.my_error_in_the_bar: the 0.05 ceiling was INHERITED from scripts/glm_encoder_gate.PREREGISTERED null_max_abs, which was set for a POOLED test set of about 11,200 rows. The active frame test set is 3,822 rows. A tolerance must come from the tested quantity, not from another arm; I did not re-derive it and that is a bar-specification error of mine.
null_diagnosis.what_is_NOT_claimed: the breach is not evidence the pipeline fabricates signal. All three breaching values are NEGATIVE; a shuffled-label model that anti-correlates has learned noise pointing the wrong way; and a conv is a smooth function of sequence rather than an independent random vector, so its spread is legitimately wider than 1/sqrt(n) = 0.0162.
null_diagnosis.what_would_fix_it_properly: re-derive the ceiling for a 3,822-row frame from a null distribution over enough replicates to estimate one, then re-freeze and re-run. Loosening it now, after seeing the result, is the post-hoc edit this project has logged twice.

finding_3_the_margin_grows_on_the_active.source: wiki/active_frame_rescore_2026-11-16.json; no model trained, arm identity by reconcile at max abs delta 0.0000
finding_3_the_margin_grows_on_the_active.reads_as: the MARGIN between an arm and GC under the SAME restriction is the readable quantity; both arms beat GC by MORE on the active frame because the GC pooled advantage was almost entirely detection. Active-frame absolutes are range-restricted on the outcome and are NOT ledger candidates.
finding_3_the_margin_grows_on_the_active.relation_to_the_scratch_measurement: the 2026-11-16 scratch used a 4-mer ridge, NOT the published conv, and fit GC WITHIN the active subset (-0.0464) rather than on the pooled train set (+0.0389). Different experiments; the numbers must not be merged. Step 3 independently reproduced the scratch -0.0464 with GC fit inside the active frame.

on_the_model_scale.why_log1p: modal_bin_share uses equal-WIDTH bins and is not scale-invariant; log1p is the target ridge_gc and the conv are fit against, so it is the scale the models see

the_scale_invariant_measure_runs_the_OTH.reads_as: the two labels are DIFFERENTLY pathological rather than one being a milder version of the other: the bacterial label has concentrated mass but nearly all-distinct values, the human labels have spread mass but are heavily tied.

finding_4_the_human_label_is_not_similar.human_ceiling_reason: no per-replicate columns were found in the deposit, so no Spearman-Brown step-up is derivable. Reported as null rather than filled with the BACTERIAL 0.941, which both wiki/eukaryotic_arm_result_*.json currently carry as context
finding_4_the_human_label_is_not_similar.no_human_reproducibility_curve: the deposit carries ZERO per-replicate columns across 6 files, so no Spearman-Brown step-up is derivable. The R2 unverified flag is now resolved in the negative.
finding_4_the_human_label_is_not_similar.WTC11: refused at join rate 0.0000 (0 of 23,064 rows), recorded rather than worked around

partially_informed: library construction / assay readout -- the two labels are measurably differently shaped, and the bacterial one has a reliability gradient the human deposit cannot even be checked for
which_of_the_four_eukaryotic_differences.honest_statement: this plan does NOT identify which of the four named differences carries the effect. It adds a FIFTH candidate -- the scoring frame -- and shows that candidate is real on the bacterial side and unmeasurable on the human side.

the_published_eukaryotic_verdict_is_UNTO.verdict_field: SUBSTRATE_LIMITED, unchanged in both wiki/eukaryotic_arm_result_HepG2_2026-11-01.json and the K562 sibling
the_published_eukaryotic_verdict_is_UNTO.verdict_detail_is_a_CI_COMPARISON: the CI for the human gain lies entirely ABOVE the bacterial gain 0.0122 -- a comparison of two measured numbers that stays true whatever this plan finds
the_published_eukaryotic_verdict_is_UNTO.lands_inside_honest_limits_0: which of the four differences carries the effect -- now five candidates
the_published_eukaryotic_verdict_is_UNTO.strengthens_honest_limits_1: the 0.0122 anchor was already flagged as a fixed point with unpropagated uncertainty; this plan upgrades that to frame-dependent
the_published_eukaryotic_verdict_is_UNTO.the_remaining_authority_call: whether those two artifacts should gain a sixth honest_limits entry. This plan position is the forward pointer only, leaving both byte-identical.

honest_limits: The decisive gate is UNGRADED. Findings 1, 3 and 4 do not depend on it, but the question the plan was built to answer -- does the published conv beat GC by more on the active frame -- has no graded answer.
The active frame conditions on the outcome. Every active-frame absolute is range-restricted; only differentials under the same restriction are readable.
modal_bin_share is not scale-invariant even on log1p: log1p is one monotone transform among many, chosen because it is what the models fit, not because it is canonical.
The reproducibility curve null reaches +0.4303 on its own, so the trend is interpretable ONLY against it. Three per-decile ceilings below 0.55 rest on 4,411 rows each.
One substrate, one organism, one assay series (GSE144621). Nothing here generalises to bacterial regulation at large.
3 null replicates in the gate is not a null distribution, which the gate own scope language says.
